# CANDIDATE: StaleDetector Implementation
**Filed:** 2026-07-02
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
The StaleDetector will identify and alert on stale TV data, triggering a reconnect or REST fallback within 15 minutes of RTH open, ensuring uninterrupted market data feed.

## Mechanism
The StaleDetector will monitor the TV data feed for three consecutive SKIP_TV_DATA_STALE signals within a 15-minute window after RTH open. Upon detection, it will trigger a reconnect attempt and alert via Discord.
